query:
SELECT k.user_id AS "user_id!: i64",
                  COALESCE(MIN(d.revoked_at IS NULL), 1) AS "live!: i64"
           FROM channel_keys k
           LEFT JOIN devices d ON d.user_id = k.user_id AND d.device_id = k.device_id
           WHERE k.channel_id = ? AND k.epoch = ?
           GROUP BY k.user_id
